description: What this project actually consumed: CPU, memory, disk, files and network over a window. These are QUANTITIES AND NOT CHARGES: fline has no price and no billing during the private beta, nothing charges for what a project uses, and using more than the ceilings is not possible because they are enforced rather than billed. Read `notes` before restating any figure: the network number counts traffic at the containers' own interfaces and is larger than what left the platform, and the memory peak is the highest of readings taken every thirty seconds rather than a true maximum. `coverage` says how much of the window actually reached us; a null figure means nothing measured it, which is not the same as zero. window is one of 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 30d and defaults to 24h. per_service defaults to false. THIS TOOL CANNOT CHANGE A PROJECT'S CLASS, and neither can any other tool or any screen of the fline dashboard: "What it may use" on the app's Web address and usage tab only shows the ceilings. If the answer is that the project has outgrown its class, say so plainly to the person and do not send them looking for a setting that does not exist.
name: get_usage
title: Get usage
